source.title: 夜雨寄北
source.author: 李商隐
source.text:
君问归期未有期，巴山夜雨涨秋池。
何当共剪西窗烛，却话巴山夜雨时。

examples.source_note: 维基文库公版原文；转简体、统一标点。E05采用不尽异文，其他不混入异文。

high.translation:
You ask when I return; no day is set.
Night rain in Ba swells the autumn pool.
When shall we trim a candle at the western window,
And speak again of this rain in Ba at night?

low.translation:
You ask when I return; the day is set.
Night rain in Ba drains the autumn pool.
When shall we trim a candle at the western window,
And speak again of this rain in Ba at night?

source.title: 丑奴儿·书博山道中壁
source.author: 辛弃疾
source.text:
少年不识愁滋味，爱上层楼。爱上层楼，为赋新词强说愁。
而今识尽愁滋味，欲说还休。欲说还休，却道天凉好个秋！

examples.source_note: 维基文库公版原文；转简体、统一标点。E05采用不尽异文，其他不混入异文。

high.translation:
In youth I did not know the taste of sorrow;
I loved to climb the tower,
I loved to climb the tower,
And forced out grief to make a fresh song.
Now I have tasted sorrow to the full;
I would speak, then stop,
I would speak, then stop,
And only say: How cool, how fine the autumn!

low.translation:
In youth I knew quite well the taste of sorrow;
I loved to climb the tower,
I loved to climb the tower,
And forced out grief to make a fresh song.
Now I have tasted sorrow to the full;
I speak freely, without stopping,
I speak freely, without stopping,
And only say: How cool, how fine the autumn!

error_ledger.description: 欲说还休的反复克制变成畅言

source.title: 芙蓉楼送辛渐
source.author: 王昌龄
source.text:
寒雨连江夜入吴，平明送客楚山孤。
洛阳亲友如相问，一片冰心在玉壶。

examples.source_url: https://zh.wikisource.org/wiki/芙蓉樓送辛漸_(寒雨連江夜入吳)
examples.source_note: 维基文库公版原文；转简体、统一标点。E05采用不尽异文，其他不混入异文。

high.translation:
Cold rain joins the river, entering Wu by night;
At dawn I see you off: the Chu hills stand alone.
If friends and kin in Luoyang ask of me,
An icy heart lies in a vessel of jade.

low.translation:
Cold rain joins the river, entering Wu at noon;
At dawn I see you off: the Chu hills stand alone.
If friends and kin in Luoyang ask of me,
A burning heart lies in a vessel of jade.

source.title: 踏莎行·雾失楼台
source.author: 秦观
source.text:
雾失楼台，月迷津渡，桃源望断无寻处。
可堪孤馆闭春寒，杜鹃声里斜阳暮。
驿寄梅花，鱼传尺素，砌成此恨无重数。
郴江幸自绕郴山，为谁流下潇湘去？

examples.source_note: 维基文库公版原文；转简体、统一标点。E05采用不尽异文，其他不混入异文。

high.translation:
Mist hides the towers; moonlight blurs the ferry.
I gaze toward Peach Blossom Spring, nowhere to be found.
How bear this lonely lodging, shut in springtime cold,
The setting sun, the cuckoo calling into dusk?
Plum blossoms sent by post, silk letters borne by fish,
Build layer upon layer of this sorrow.
The Chen River had its own hills to wind around;
For whom does it flow down toward Xiao and Xiang?

low.translation:
Mist reveals the towers; moonlight blurs the ferry.
I gaze toward Peach Blossom Spring, clearly to be found.
How bear this lonely lodging, shut in springtime cold,
The setting sun, the cuckoo calling into dusk?
Plum blossoms sent by post, silk letters borne by fish,
Build layer upon layer of this sorrow.
The Chen River had its own hills to wind around;
For whom does it flow down toward Xiao and Xiang?

source.title: 早发白帝城
source.author: 李白
source.text:
朝辞白帝彩云间，千里江陵一日还。
两岸猿声啼不尽，轻舟已过万重山。

examples.source_note: 维基文库公版原文；转简体、统一标点。E05采用不尽异文，其他不混入异文。

source.title: 采桑子·轻舟短棹西湖好
source.author: 欧阳修
source.text:
轻舟短棹西湖好，绿水逶迤，芳草长堤，隐隐笙歌处处随。
无风水面琉璃滑，不觉船移，微动涟漪，惊起沙禽掠岸飞。

examples.source_note: 维基文库公版原文；转简体、统一标点。E05采用不尽异文，其他不混入异文。

high.translation:
West Lake is lovely: a light boat, short oars,
Green water winding,
A long bank of fragrant grass,
Faint pipes and singing follow everywhere.
No wind; the water lies as smooth as glass.
I hardly feel the boat move;
Small ripples stir,
Startling the shorebirds into flight along the bank.

low.translation:
West Lake is lovely: a light boat, short oars,
Green water winding,
A long bank of fragrant grass,
Faint pipes and singing follow everywhere.
Strong wind; the water lies as smooth as glass.
I hardly feel the boat move;
Small ripples stir,
Startling the shorebirds into sleep along the bank.

source.title: 竹里馆
source.author: 王维
source.text:
独坐幽篁里，弹琴复长啸。
深林人不知，明月来相照。

examples.source_note: 维基文库公版原文；转简体、统一标点。E05采用不尽异文，其他不混入异文。

high.translation:
Alone I sit among secluded bamboo,
Playing the qin, then giving a long clear cry.
Deep in the woods, unknown to other people,
I have the bright moon shining here with me.

low.translation:
With friends sitting among secluded bamboo,
Playing the qin, then giving a long clear cry.
Deep in the woods, well-known to other people,
I have the bright moon shining here with me.

error_ledger.description: 独坐变成与朋友同坐，故意保留生硬句法

source.title: 清平乐·红笺小字
source.author: 晏殊
source.text:
红笺小字，说尽平生意。鸿雁在云鱼在水，惆怅此情难寄。
斜阳独倚西楼，遥山恰对帘钩。人面不知何处，绿波依旧东流。

examples.source_note: 维基文库公版原文；转简体、统一标点。E05采用不尽异文，其他不混入异文。

high.translation:
Small writing on red paper
Tells all the feelings of my life.
Geese are among the clouds, fish in the water;
Sadly, this love is hard to send.
Alone I lean in the west tower at sunset;
Distant hills face the curtain hooks.
Where is that face? I do not know.
The green waves still flow east.

low.translation:
Small writing on red paper
Tells all the feelings of my life.
Geese are among the clouds, fish in the water;
Sadly, this love is easy to send.
Alone I lean in the west tower at sunset;
Distant hills face the curtain hooks.
Where is that face? I do not know.
The green waves still flow west.
